name: orchestra
description: Orchestra — AI-Native Workflow Automation and Orchestration Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker,ai -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @algoverge/api" "npm run dev -w @algoverge/web" "npm run dev -w @algoverge/worker" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orchestra/shared && npm run build -w @orchestra/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit
